about.title: The Story of Makiti Group
about.subtitle: The Makiti Group adventure officially began on March 1, 2023, with its main headquarters established in Paris, France. This company is the fruit of the bold vision of MJ, a young Cameroonian entrepreneur residing in Europe. Her fundamental objective is to propel the IT ecosystem in Africa, with particular attention to Cameroon.

theStoryOfMakiti.title: The Story of Makiti Group
theStoryOfMakiti.p1: Today, many large European companies turn to India for their IT service outsourcing. However, this approach often presents major challenges: the language barrier (English being the only common language) and a significant time difference that can be up to 5 hours compared to France.
theStoryOfMakiti.p2: With Makiti Group, MJ's ambition is to make African talent available to European companies, while guaranteeing unparalleled quality service and resources. We have made fluid communication a priority. At Makiti Group, our staff is not only highly technically qualified but also multilingual. Beyond English, we distinguish ourselves by our proficiency in German. This allows our clients from Luxembourg, Switzerland, and of course Germany, to communicate with our developers in their native language. This ease of exchange is crucial for precise requirement transmission and harmonious collaboration.

growthAndAchievements.title: Growth and Achievements
growthAndAchievements.p1: The year 2024 was marked by a significant development of our teams. We recruited a diverse range of exceptional profiles: Java and React Developers, Site & Reliability Engineers, UX/UI Designers, Graphic Designers, and Test Automation Engineers.
growthAndAchievements.p2: These talents have already led to the realization of several innovative internal products, such as {{link1}} and {{link2}}.
growthAndAchievements.p3: In parallel, we have successfully completed numerous projects for our clients and partners, thereby strengthening our reputation for reliability and excellence.
growthAndAchievements.p4: Makiti Group bridges African technological potential with European market needs, building connections beyond borders and time zones.
